W1 preserves historical provider-label discrepancies, unknown harness versions, run-revision availability differences, single-run design, and authentication/serving-path uncertainty without paper eligibility or outcome interpretation.

provenance_strength.w1_treatment: admit the committed factual outcomes and keep historical implementation/version and provider-routing uncertainty explicit

protocol_deviations_and_failures.detail: Each committed result contains one outcome for each of five tasks; W1 does not infer variance.

The Claude Code result labels provider openai while the Copilot result labels provider anthropic. Current pinned agent configs also use different authentication/provider mechanisms. W1 preserves this discrepancy rather than normalizing it.
Committed result metadata records version as unknown. W1 leaves canonical historical linkage unresolved.

non_admission_dispositions.reason: Tier assignment is an evaluative presentation layer and is unnecessary for preserving the underlying success counts.
W1 preserves result identities for later eligibility review but does not rank or interpret harnesses by elapsed time.
